interface I {
  [k: symbol]: number;
}
const s: symbol = Symbol("s");
const u = Symbol("u");
const i: I = { [s]: 1 };
console.log(i[s], i[u]);
const bad = i["x"];
const o = { [s]: "a", b: 1 };
const n: number = o[s];
const w: { [k: symbol]: number } = { [s]: "x" };
const ro = { [s]: 1 } as const;
ro[s] = 2;
const k: keyof I = "a";
const ia: I[symbol] = "a";
const unknownName: { [k: symbol]: number } = { a: 1 };
const noContext: { [k: string]: (x: number) => number } = { [u]: (x) => x };
const withContext: { [k: symbol]: (x: number) => number } = { [u]: (x) => x };
const symbolsOnly: { [k: string]: number } = { [u]: 1 };

  const both = { [key]: 1, [key.toString()]: "x", a: true };
